import re

with open('/app/resources/treasury_bulletin_1956_08.txt', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find the section
start_idx = content.find("Monthly series beginning April 1953")
if start_idx > 0:
    section = content[start_idx:start_idx+4500]
    lines = section.split('\n')
    
# Parse the data
# The table has period | 10-20yr | 20yr+ | corporate in each group of 4 columns
# The lines alternate between having year prefixes or not

data = []
current_year = 1953

for line in lines:
    # Split by |
    parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split('|') if p.strip()]
    if len(parts) < 4:
        continue
    
    # Check if first part is a year-month like "1953-Apr."
    match = re.match(r'(\d{4})-([A-Za-z]+)\.?', parts[0])
    if match:
        current_year = int(match.group(1))
        month_str = match.group(2)
        # Yield is parts[2] (20 years and after)
        try:
            yield_val = float(parts[2])
            data.append((f"{current_year}-{month_str}", yield_val))
            print(f"{current_year}-{month_str}: {yield_val}")
        except:
            pass
    elif len(parts) >= 3:
